$comment: Home page news manifest for the Evolution client. Editing this file publishes announcements without redeploying the app. Fields: id (unique, stable — player dismissals key off it), date (ISO, drives ordering + display), tone (arcane | gold | blue), link (optional, internal route or https URL), image (optional thumbnail, same-origin path or https URL), expiresAt (optional ISO instant, hides the item after it), title/summary (per-locale, a missing locale falls back to the other). The home panel shows the 3 newest non-expired, non-dismissed items.
